There were only just a few persons that understand her. She used to have an imaginary friend called Tom, she forgot about it when she got older but the name remained in her consciousness. She always liked books, specially romantic ones, and when she started writing she always used the name "Tom" for the male character. Even now as an adult and with a partner she still uses the name Tom for her novels. It has become some kind of default name for her male characters on different stories, even the erotic ones, the name doesn't actually have some meaning for her, she just got accustomed at this point. She's trying to get better at writing so she can beat AI generated ebooks on Amazon's Kindle direct publishing, which means she's starting to acknowledge all her self inserts in her stories.
